raw_segments.text: Those systems, therefore, which preferring agriculture to all other employments, in order
to promote it, impose restraints upon manufacturers and foreign trade, act contrary to the very
end which they propose, and indirectly discourage that very species of industry which they mean
They are so far, perhaps, more inconsistent than even the mercantile system.
That system, by encouraging manufacturers and foreign trade more than agriculture,
turns a certain portion of the capital of the society, from supporting a more advantageous,
to support a less advantageous species of industry.
